items.title: Europe Tonight: Europe faces tough budget negotiations
items.summary: To debrief on the EU's passing of its budget, our correspondent Maria Tadeo spoke to Slovak MEP for Progressive Slovakia within the Renew Europe group Lucia Yar on Euronews' new weekly evening show Europe Tonight.

items.title: Protesters clash with police over Venezuela’s poor minimum wage
items.summary: Labour organisers shared videos of police violently clashing with protesters near Venezuela’s presidential palace.
